notes: Agent model values are Claude Code slots, not raw OpenRouter IDs.
Slots route through registry: haiku=cheapFull, sonnet=main, opus=hard.
Policy keeps cheap/read-only agents inexpensive and reserves hard model for architecture.
Claude Code resolves subagent models from CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL first, then invocation, then frontmatter. This LTS uses frontmatter mode, so the global override is intentionally unset.
This policy verifies installed agents match intended slots and never changes models silently.

context-scout.reason: Read-only context scouting should be cheap and frequent.

test-runner.reason: Validation command selection is mostly procedural.

researcher.reason: Research summaries should stay cheap unless escalated manually.

ui-designer.reason: Visual direction needs main model quality.

frontend-implementer.reason: Implementation should use main coding model.

frontend-reviewer.reason: Frontend review needs design and code judgment.

security-reviewer.reason: Default security review stays high-quality without forcing hard model every time.
